name.description: The fork's name: the repository's own when absent.

repo.description: The repository to fork: its dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The account owns the repository, has a repository by that name already, or the name is not one a repository can have.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

main.description: Copies a repository, every branch and tag, into a new dev.knotless.repo in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, naming it as forked from the first, as `knotless repo fork` does. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account.

description: Forks a repository into the account logged in to this appview's pages.
